title: PDF page is A4 landscape with 25px margins and a footer with the ShopView label and page numbers
custom_preconds: 1. You have downloaded the PDF for a view with enough rows to span more than one page.
custom_steps:
1. Open the PDF and check the page setup.
2. Read the footer on each page.
custom_expected:
1. The PDF is A4 landscape with 25px margins on all sides, using the application's standard font.
2. The footer has a centered "Software Powered by ShopView" label and a right-aligned page number "Page X of Y."
